cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
NVIDIA 本体层项目
日增四天涨到 2,467
cover.dek: NVIDIA 开源的 auto-ontology 给 Agent 做语义图和本体推理，日增四天内从 25 爬到 2,467。HN 上 289 分、139 条评论，讨论是自发的。
cover.title_en:
NVIDIA's auto-ontology
goes from 25 to 2,467 a day
cover.dek_en: NVIDIA's open-source auto-ontology gives agents a semantic graph and ontology reasoning layer. Daily star gains went from 25 to 2,467 in four days, and the 289-point, 139-comment HN thread is organic.
